**Senstar Celebrates Its 45th Anniversary!**


***Milestone Year Includes Expansion into High-Growth 3D LiDAR Market Through Blickfeld Acquisition***


Ottawa, Canada – November 13, 2026 – Senstar, a world leader in perimeter intrusion detection systems (PIDS), video management, video analytics, access control and 3D LiDAR, is celebrating 45 years since its incorporation in 1981.


Headquartered in Canada’s capital city, Ottawa, Senstar was established with the objective of bringing security technologies originally targeted for military applications to the commercial market. Initially a seven-employee company, Senstar now has employees and service centers around the world. Its market-leading products are found in more than 100 countries at tens of thousands of sites.


“2026 has been a particularly significant year for Senstar, with the acquisition of Blickfeld and the addition of 3D LiDAR technology to our portfolio,” said Chief Executive Officer Fabien Haubert. “LiDAR gives our customers precise, three-dimensional detection – a new way to address and solve key security problems.”


Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, Blickfeld develops 3D LiDAR sensors with integrated software, including QbProtect, a LiDAR device optimized for security applications. Its technology complements Senstar’s fence, buried and above-ground sensors and has the potential to extend Senstar’s reach into new markets, including volume and traffic monitoring and the protection of transport facilities, museums and cultural institutions. Senstar completed the acquisition in February 2026.


“Forty-five years after our founding, we are proud of the path Senstar has taken and excited about where it leads,” added Haubert. “Our aim is to keep innovating on behalf of our customers’ needs, with a focus on high-growth markets and complex projects worldwide – from utilities, data centers and energy to corrections and airports. I want to thank our employees for their dedication and our customers for the trust they have placed in us over the years.”


**About Senstar Technologies Corporation**


With innovative perimeter intrusion detection systems (including fence sensors, buried sensors, and above ground sensors), intelligent video-management, video analytics, and access control, Senstar offers a comprehensive suite of proven, integrated solutions that reduce complexity, improve performance, and unify support. For 45 years, Senstar has been safeguarding people, places, and property for organizations around the world, with a special focus on utilities, logistics, correction facilities and energy markets.
